paper_id: A Comparative Study on Regularization Strategies for Embedding-based Neural Networks__oa_W2165560648
title: A Comparative Study on Regularization Strategies for Embedding-based Neural Networks
motivation: Embedding-based neural NLP models suffer severe overfitting due to high dimensionality
problem_framing: Compare four regularization strategies systematically on CNN and RNN for relation extraction and sentiment
key_insight: L2 of embeddings helps optimization; regularization acts locally; weights and embeddings are complementary when combined
method_signature: Systematic comparison of penalizing weights, penalizing embeddings, re-embedding, and dropout
evaluation_criteria: Training vs validation accuracy improvement; generalization gain across dataset sizes
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Re-embedding words is not effective; dropout performs slightly worse than L2 penalty in experiments
evidence_for_taste: mainly serves as a local effect
thinking_moves: 从超参搜索耗时出发,探索增量调参可行性
把regularization的作用分为优化帮助和泛化帮助两类
对比不同正则化策略的互补性而非单独最优
从相同样本量出发,实验结果在类似场景可推广
